findings.title: Inconsistent casing for zone identifier
findings.body: The new field `shipping_zone` uses UPPER_CASE, while the rest of the module uses snake_case for identifiers (e.g., `order_id`, `destination`). This breaks the local naming convention established in the same module.

summary.problem: The new `shipping_zone` field introduces an inconsistent casing style in an otherwise snake_case module.
summary.done_well: The change adds a useful shipping zone field and maintains the existing return structure pattern.
